title: ActMem: From Latent Memory Reasoning to Grounded Robotic Action
title_zh: ActMem：从潜在记忆推理到感知引导的机器人动作
abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promising results in real-world long-horizon manipulation, where memory plays a crucial role. However, existing memory-augmented VLAs either retrieve past observations without reasoning about what they imply, or reason over the full history in a shared context where it crowds out current perception. Cognitive science treats them as distinct systems: memory reconstructs past experience to decide what to do, while perception guides how to act. We therefore propose ActMem, an in-context memory framework that decouples memory reasoning from perceptual grounding within a single vision-language backbone. Built on a vision-language model with native video understanding, ActMem infers the current subtask from a timestamped interaction history and keeps the hidden states formed during this inference as a Latent Memory Chain-of-Thought (Memory CoT), which conditions a flow-matching action expert. Perception Attention further lets the expert attend directly to the current view. To keep inference fast under long histories, Efficient Memory CoT Inference reuses computation across consecutive decisions without changing the output. ActMem achieves 71.1% task success and 80.8% completion success on RoboMemArena, surpassing the strongest baseline by 7.5 and 8.7 percentage points, and 73.8% average success on MIKASA-Robo, the best among all compared methods. In the real world, it reaches 68.8% average success on exogenous, endogenous, and traceless memory tasks, 10.0 percentage points above the strongest memory-augmented VLA. Code and checkpoints will be released at https://github.com/LigphiDonk/ActMem and https://huggingface.co/donk111/ActMem.
abstract_zh: 在长时程机器人操作中，记忆帮助模型决定「做什么」，当前感知则指导模型「怎么做」。现有的记忆增强型视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型要么只检索过去的观测而不推理其含义，要么在共享上下文中处理完整历史，挤占当前感知所需的上下文空间。ActMem 在同一个原生支持视频理解的视觉-语言骨干中，将记忆推理与当前感知引导解耦。模型根据带时间戳的交互历史推断当前子任务，并将推理过程中产生的隐藏状态保留为潜在记忆思维链（Latent Memory Chain-of-Thought，Memory CoT），用于调节基于流匹配（flow matching）的动作专家。Perception Attention 让动作专家直接关注当前画面；Efficient Memory CoT Inference 则在连续决策间复用计算，在不改变输出的前提下降低长历史下的推理开销。ActMem 在 RoboMemArena 上的任务成功率和完成成功率分别为 71.1% 和 80.8%，较最强基线分别提升 7.5 和 8.7 个百分点；在 MIKASA-Robo 上的平均成功率为 73.8%，在对比方法中最高；在真实机器人的三类记忆任务上，平均成功率为 68.8%，比最强记忆增强型 VLA 高 10.0 个百分点。
key_points_zh: Memory CoT 保留子任务推理的隐藏状态，将历史交互中与决策相关的信息传给流匹配动作专家。
Perception Attention 让动作专家直接读取当前画面，使动作执行不只依赖记忆表征。
Efficient Memory CoT Inference 在相邻决策间复用计算，不改变推理输出。
ActMem 在 RoboMemArena 的两项指标上分别领先最强基线 7.5 和 8.7 个百分点，在 MIKASA-Robo 上以 73.8% 的平均成功率位居对比方法首位。
真实机器人实验覆盖外源（exogenous）、内源（endogenous）和无痕（traceless）记忆任务，平均成功率达 68.8%，领先最强记忆增强型 VLA 10.0 个百分点。
